blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: arbor, gazebo, pavilion (a shady place for sitting)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: пе́чка — stove, oven; поса́дка — planting; бесе́дка — arbor, gazebo, pavilion (a shady place for sitting); прыжок — jump, leap, bound.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: ре́зка — cutting; рассу́док — reason, sense, senses; вы́ставка — exhibiting, showing; вы́писка — writing out, copying.
